label: inventory
//: Deliberately awkward data, to exercise the schema derivation in src/openapi/schema.ts. The label is not a plural, so no trailing s is stripped from the schema name. name is consistently a string; score mixes integer and float (widens to number); active is boolean; tags is an array; meta is an object; note is null in one entry and a string in the other (a lone null carries no type, so the string wins); blank is null in every entry, so no type can be inferred at all; mixed conflicts outright (string vs object, so no type is claimed); extra appears in only one entry.
